It was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]] and released by [[Dorling Kindersley|DK Publishing]] on [[November 2]], [[2023]] in the United Kingdom and [[December 5]], [[2023]] in the United States. ==Publisher's summary== '''''The latest in DK's Star Wars Visual Dictionary/Visual Guide series, featuring all the new Disney+''''' '''Obi-Wan Kenobi''' '''''and''''' '''Andor''' '''''content, going behind the lines of the first rebels in their fight against the Empire''''' '''''Take a deep dive into a turbulent era of the''''' '''Star Wars''' '''''galaxy, connecting the Prequel and Original trilogies and''''' '''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story''' ''For many years, the state of the galaxy between'' Revenge of the Sith ''and'' A New Hope ''was a mystery to'' Star Wars ''fans. With the release of'' Star Wars Rebels ''and'' Rogue One'', and more recently,'' Obi-Wan Kenobi ''and'' Andor'', an exciting new era has begun to emerge—the Dawn of Rebellion.'' ''Before Luke Skywalker ever picked up a lightsaber, the rebels were scattered and desperate bands of idealists, fighting their own battles against the might of the Empire. Victories were few, losses high, and danger ever-present. This Visual Guide charts this darkest of times, revealing all key characters, locations, vehicles, and weapons from the hit Disney+ series'' Obi-Wan Kenobi ''and'' Andor''. With exclusive new cross-section artwork.'' ==Development== ''Star Wars Dawn of Rebellion The Visual Guide'' was officially announced on [[March 9]], [[2023]]. On [[April 12]], co-author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed that the first draft for the book was just completed.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1646321136454766592|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-04-12|quote=Just finished the first draft this week.|archivedate=20230507045942}} ==Continuity== According to ''Dawn of Rebellion,'' [[Alexsandr Kallus' squad]] was lost in [[7 BBY]]. However, the earlier 2023 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' had dated the attack to [[18 BBY]] and placed another Kallus appearance, his mission for the Empire in "[[Flight of the Falcon, Part 1: Spy Games]]" around [[10 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' and its [[2024]] update ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' list Kallus's mission to Onderon as his first mission for the Empire.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' Given the ''Timelines'' date for "Spy Games" and the fact that the Onderon attack must be Kallus's first mission, there is no way the attack can occur in 7 BBY. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide}} ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9780744087345}};
